scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($c){ Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Host 'Stopped existing server on port 5000' } else { Write-Host 'No server running on port 5000' }"
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
